## How I checked it

- [ ] `mise run check:fast` passes
- [ ] `mise run check` passes (before review)
- [ ] `mise run web:e2e` passes (for a core or web change)
- [ ] No photo, and no picture made from a photo, is in this change
- [ ] Reference or golden pictures moved only for a meant change, and the commit says why
- [ ] I added or deleted the row in `docs/LEFTOVERS.md` if this touches a known problem
